## migrate() function

No-op in v0.1.0 per §8.1 of the spec. Always returns `status: 'no-migrations-needed'` because §9.4 constrains every `schemaVersion` to a single value. When real migrations ship, this must distinguish up-to-date from unknown-future-version.
